name: recon_report
description: Run a full passive recon sweep on a domain or IP and return ONE structured report, instead of chaining dns_lookup/whois/ssl_checker/subdomain_enum/header_analyzer/threat_intel manually across separate turns. Use for 'do a recon on X', 'security overview of this domain', CTF/coursework target profiling, or checking a host before trusting it. Deliberately passive-only — does NOT run port_scanner (that skill requires explicit user confirmation before an active scan for good reason; run it separately if an active scan is actually wanted).

target.description: A domain (e.g. 'example.com') or IP address to profile.

depth.description: quick: DNS + WHOIS/host-info + SSL expiry + threat intel only (fastest). standard (default): quick + HTTP security header audit + passive subdomain enumeration via crt.sh. deep: standard + slower active-DNS subdomain brute-force. None of these run a port scan.
